item.title: Army Downed More Than 1,400 Iranian Missiles And Drones During Epic Fury And 12-Day War
item.summary: The Army's air and missile defense boss offered new context about how the service defended against Iranian threats in the two most recent Middle East conflicts. The post Army Downed More Than 1,400 Iranian Missiles And Drones During Epic Fury And 12-Day War appeared first on TWZ .
